app/navigation.entryDescription: Choose a local verification feature. Opening a page never starts capture automatically.

settings/language.title: Language
settings/language.description: Choose the app language. Follow system uses the first supported Chinese or English language on your device.
settings/language.saveError: Could not save the language preference. The current selection is unchanged.

acquisition/active.screenDescription: After you explicitly grant permission, you can enumerate cameras and inspect their capabilities. Opening the camera and starting a capture are separate actions. This local flow does not depend on cloud sign-in or service configuration.
acquisition/active.queryDescription: Permission, camera enumeration, and capability queries do not open the camera, enable the torch, bind a preview, or create session files. Granting permission and running queries are separate actions.
acquisition/active.selectCamera: Select a camera for this query
acquisition/active.queryCapabilities: Query selected camera capabilities and combination
acquisition/active.queryLoading: Reading static camera information; no preview use case is bound…
acquisition/active.deviceDetailsUnavailable: The device did not provide a translatable detail.
acquisition/active.configDescription: The camera and parameters are frozen when opened and cannot be changed during preview or capture. Query the combination again after changing the resolution or FPS.
acquisition/active.deviceEvStep: The unit is the device-reported EV step.
acquisition/active.torchUnavailable: Unsupported or not confirmed on this device
acquisition/active.frameGeometryPending: Actual frame geometry: not received yet
acquisition/active.queryBeforeOpen: Query the selected camera and current resolution first
acquisition/active.waitingForNative: Waiting for the native operation to finish…
acquisition/active.hintsDisclaimer: These hints are for debugging only. They do not validate image coverage, signal quality, or medical accuracy, and they never block capture.
acquisition/active.artifactHasNoConfig: This artifact has no recorded configuration summary.
acquisition/active.artifactQueryScope: This list queries successfully closed session references from the current process only; it does not scan disk. The list resets after a process restart, while completed files remain in the app-private directory.
acquisition/active.artifactLimitNote: When there are more than 20 results, only the last 20 are shown. Other files are not deleted or cleaned up.
acquisition/active.errorUnknown: The operation failed. Try again; if the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.
acquisition/active.errorPermission: Camera permission was not granted. Check system permissions and try again.
acquisition/active.errorCapability: The current camera capabilities or configuration combination could not be confirmed. Query the device again.
acquisition/active.errorConfiguration: The camera configuration is invalid or the device does not support the selected setting. Check the values and try again.
acquisition/active.errorCameraBusy: The camera is in use. Close other camera sessions and try again.
acquisition/active.errorCamera: The camera operation could not be completed. Check permission and device status, then try again.
acquisition/active.errorFile: The capture files could not be finalized. Check available storage and try again.
acquisition/active.errorCapture: The capture session did not complete. Close the camera and start a new session.
acquisition/active.errorPlatform: This feature is available only on Android devices.
acquisition/active.errorGeneric: The operation failed. Try again; if the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.

acquisition/passive.screenDescription: The background service waits for a new device-unlock event only after you explicitly enable it and grant camera and notification permissions. When the configured interval allows it, the service records full front-camera video directly; it does not show a preview, record audio, filter faces, or calculate PPG.
acquisition/passive.privacyNotice: Videos stay in the app-private directory and are not uploaded or cleaned up automatically. The camera is released while waiting; disabling the service cancels an unfinished clip. Android controls the system notification and camera privacy indicator.
acquisition/passive.reasonWaitingForUnlock: Waiting for a new device unlock; the camera is released.
acquisition/passive.reasonConfigurationSaved: Configuration saved; service is not enabled.
acquisition/passive.reasonServiceStartRequested: Requesting the foreground service to start.
acquisition/passive.reasonUnlockTriggered: An unlock opportunity arrived; trying to open the front camera.
acquisition/passive.reasonCycleNotElapsed: This unlock was before the interval elapsed; the camera stayed closed.
acquisition/passive.reasonCaptureBusy: The previous recording or its finalization is still in progress; this opportunity was skipped.
acquisition/passive.reasonCameraBusy: The camera is owned by active capture; this opportunity was skipped.
acquisition/passive.reasonVideoCompleted: The video was finalized and published.
acquisition/passive.reasonScreenLocked: The device locked again; the unfinished clip was cancelled.
acquisition/passive.reasonUserDisabled: Passive capture was disabled by the user.
acquisition/passive.errorTitle: Passive capture could not complete the operation
acquisition/passive.errorPermission: A camera permission or notification requirement is not met. Check app permissions and the notification channel, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorCameraBusy: The camera is owned by another capture session. Wait for that session to finish, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorCamera: The camera operation could not complete. Check the device state, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorService: The background capture service could not complete the operation. Check system restrictions on background activity, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorConfiguration: The capture interval or recording duration is invalid. Check the configuration, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorFile: The video could not be finalized or read. Check available storage, then try again.
acquisition/passive.errorPlatform: Passive capture is supported only on Android.
acquisition/passive.errorGeneric: The operation failed. Try again. If the problem persists, note the error code and contact support.
acquisition/passive.openAppSettings: Open app permission and notification settings
acquisition/passive.guidanceMessage: Some manufacturers restrict background activity. On HONOR devices, open Settings > Apps > This app > Battery usage > App launch, turn off “Manage automatically”, and enable “Allow background activity”. Do not enable “Auto-launch” or “Secondary launch”. These are manufacturer settings, not Android runtime permissions, and the app cannot inspect or grant them. After changing this setting, return to the app, tap Enable again, and choose “Done / not applicable, continue”. If your device has no such setting, continue directly. Manufacturer labels and paths can vary.
acquisition/passive.cycleHint: The first new unlock opportunity after enabling may record. Later intervals are measured from the actual start of each recording.
acquisition/passive.enable: Grant permissions and enable passive capture
acquisition/passive.commandPending: Waiting for the native service and camera session to finish…
acquisition/passive.artifactQueryScope: This list scans the app-private directory for completed, readable videos; unfinished or cancelled temporary clips are not shown.
acquisition/passive.artifactLimitNote: When there are more than 20 results, only 20 query results are shown. Other files remain in the app-private directory.
acquisition/passive.cancelledVideoDescription: Cancelled or failed temporary clips do not appear in this list.

sensors/capture.screenDescription: The four sensors are controlled independently. Creating clients, checking capabilities, and switching pages do not start capture; high-frequency samples stay on the Android native side.
sensors/capture.coordinateSystem: Android natural device coordinates; axes do not rotate with the screen
sensors/capture.capabilityUnavailable: This default sensor is not provided by the device
sensors/capture.unavailableTitle: This sensor type is unavailable on this device.
sensors/capture.unavailableMessage: No other sensor or algorithm will be used to fabricate data.
sensors/capture.samplingDisclaimer: The registered parameter is not a stable actual sampling rate; event timestamps reflect what the system delivers.
sensors/capture.errorGeneric: The sensor operation failed. Try again. If the problem persists, note the error code and contact support.
sensors/capture.errorInvalidConfig: The sampling interval must be an integer from 5,000 to 1,000,000 μs.
sensors/capture.errorUnavailable: The device does not provide this default sensor.
sensors/capture.errorBusy: This sensor still has an active capture; wait for it to stop before retrying.
sensors/capture.errorRegistration: The system could not start listening to this sensor. Try again later.
sensors/capture.errorBackground: Capture was interrupted when the app entered the background. Start a new capture manually after returning.
sensors/capture.errorRuntime: The sensor runtime was interrupted. Start capture manually again.
sensors/capture.errorNotCapturing: There is no sensor session to stop.
sensors/capture.errorNoSamples: This session received no samples, so no completed file is available.
sensors/capture.errorData: The sensor returned invalid data; this session could not complete.
sensors/capture.errorCapacity: Sensor data processing could not keep up with input; this session was interrupted.
sensors/capture.errorFile: The sensor CSV could not be completed. Check available storage and try again.
sensors/capture.errorMissingArtifact: The stop operation did not return a completed sensor file.
sensors/capture.artifactLimitNote: When there are more than 20 results, only the last 20 references are shown. The list does not delete or clean up other files.
sensors/capture.currentProcessNote: This list queries completed references from the current process only. It resets after process restart; completed files remain.
sensors/capture.refresh: Refresh device capabilities and completed files
sensors/capture.pageLifecycleNote: This page subscribes to low-frequency state and queries devices; it does not sample. Switching pages or removing the subscription does not stop a running sensor.
